message.content:
READ-ONLY, quick, on the LIVE Soul Pilates CRM at **51.79.226.200**. NO writes. Just break down one invoice's line items.

## Access (SAFE, read-only, never print the plaintext password)
ssh2 to .200 via the platform approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`; mirror lib/sftp.ts). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before every command. READ ONLY.

## The task
Invoice **SP-INV-260809-0004** (id `6a78c64e…` — find it in the Invoices collection; it has a STRIPE payment of 2,362,500). Dump and explain exactly what makes up the **2,362,500**:
- The full list of **line items** (each item's description/name, unit price, quantity, line total) — packages, classes, merchandise/add-ons, vouchers, etc.
- Any **discount**, **promo code**, and especially any **online/Stripe processing fee** or surcharge added to the total (the code nets out "online fees" somewhere — check whether the customer-charged total includes a Stripe fee on top of the item subtotal).
- The **subtotal, discount, fee, and TotalNet**, and show the arithmetic that sums to 2,362,500 (e.g. "2,000,000 package + 362,500 X").
- Which **client** this invoice is for, and the item(s) purchased.
Look at the Invoice document's line-items/fields directly, and cross-check the InvoiceService/PaymentService for how an online (Stripe) fee is computed/added if one is present.

## Report
A short, clear breakdown: what the 2,362,500 is composed of (itemized), including whether a Stripe/online fee accounts for the odd 362,500, and who bought it. Evidence-based, read-only.
